```{r load data}
# ================================
# 1. Load libraries
# ================================
library(pheatmap)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(tidyverse)
library(M3C)
library(ggplot2)
library(limma)
library(factoextra)
library(variancePartition)
library(BiocParallel)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# ================================
# 2. Load data
# ================================
CSF_data <- read.csv("~/Desktop/KV1.3_CSF.PAP1.30july2025/CSF_PAP1_Proteinid_50percent_IMPUTATION_matrix.unique.csv",
                     row.names = 1)
CSF_metadata <- readRDS("~/Desktop/KV1.3_CSF.PAP1.30july2025/CSF.KV1.3.Proteomics.Analysis/CSF_PAP1_Metadata.rds")
CSF_metadata <- CSF_metadata[colnames(CSF_data), ]  # match order

# ================================
# 3. Define blood contamination markers (mouse) in lowercase
# ================================
#blood_markers_mouse <- c("cd24", "cd235a", "cd45", "ter119", "glya", "cd71","cd49d", "hla-dr", "cd33", "cd11b", "hbb", "spi1", "alas2", "hba2")

#blood_markers_mouse <- c("Hba", "Hbb", "Hbd", "Alb", "Tf", "Fga", "Fgb", "Fgg", "Hp", "Hpx", "Apoa1", "Apoa2", "Apoe")
blood_markers_mouse <- c("Alb", "Ighg1", "Ighg2b", "Ighg2c", "Ighg3", "Ighm", "Trf", "Fga", "Fgb", "Fgg", "Hba-a1", "Hbb-b1", "C3", "C4a", "C4b", "Serpina1a", "A2m", "Apoa1", "Apob", "Apoe", "Hp", "Fth1", "Ftl1", "Cp", "F8", "Vwf", "F2", "Serpinc1", "Plg", "Vegfa")

blood_markers <- blood_markers_mouse[blood_markers_mouse %in% rownames(CSF_data)]

if (length(blood_markers) == 0) stop("No blood contamination markers found in dataset!")

# ================================
# 4. Blood contamination score
# ================================
blood_matrix <- t(CSF_data[blood_markers, ])
blood_score <- rowMeans(blood_matrix)
CSF_metadata$blood_score <- blood_score

# ================================
# 5. VPA BEFORE correction
# ================================
form <- ~ blood_score + (1|Group)
vpa_before <- fitExtractVarPartModel(as.matrix(CSF_data), form, CSF_metadata, BPPARAM = SnowParam(4))
p1 <- plotVarPart(vpa_before) + ggtitle("VPA - BEFORE Blood Correction")
p1

blood_var_before <- mean(vpa_before["blood_score", ])

# ================================
# 6. PCA BEFORE correction (annotated)
# ================================
pca_before <- prcomp(t(CSF_data), scale. = TRUE)
p_pca_before <- fviz_pca_ind(pca_before, geom = "point", habillage = CSF_metadata$Group, addEllipses = TRUE) +
                ggtitle("PCA - BEFORE Blood Correction")

blood_loadings_before <- as.data.frame(pca_before$rotation)
blood_loadings_before$Protein <- rownames(blood_loadings_before)
blood_annot_before <- blood_loadings_before %>% filter(tolower(Protein) %in% blood_markers_mouse)

p_pca_before <- p_pca_before +
  geom_text_repel(data = blood_annot_before, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Protein),
                  color = "red", size = 10, inherit.aes = FALSE)


p_pca_before
```


```{r Part2}
# ================================
# 7. Regress out blood effect
# ================================
corrected_data <- removeBatchEffect(CSF_data, covariates = CSF_metadata$blood_score)

# ================================
# 8. VPA AFTER correction
# ================================
vpa_after <- fitExtractVarPartModel(as.matrix(corrected_data), form, CSF_metadata, BPPARAM = SnowParam(4))
head(vpa_after, 5)


# Check for NA values
summary(vpa_after)

# Replace NA with 0 (or filter them out)
vpa_after_clean <- vpa_after
vpa_after_clean[is.na(vpa_after_clean)] <- 0

# Re-plot VPA after cleaning
p2 <- plotVarPart(vpa_after_clean) + 
  ggtitle("VPA - AFTER Blood Correction")

p2

# Recalculate blood variance effect
blood_var_after <- mean(vpa_after_clean["blood_score", ], na.rm = TRUE)
variance_reduction <- ((blood_var_before - blood_var_after) / blood_var_before) * 100

cat("Blood effect variance reduced by:", round(variance_reduction, 2), "%\n")

# Annotated plot
p2_annotated <- p2 +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2, y = max(vpa_after_clean, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
           label = paste0("Blood effect ↓ ", round(variance_reduction, 1), "%"),
           color = "red", size = 5, fontface = "bold")

p2_annotated



```


```{r Third part}
# 9. PCA AFTER correction (annotated)
# ================================
pca_after <- prcomp(t(corrected_data), scale. = TRUE)
p_pca_after <- fviz_pca_ind(pca_after, geom = "point", habillage = CSF_metadata$Group, addEllipses = TRUE) +
               ggtitle("PCA - AFTER Blood Correction")

blood_loadings_after <- as.data.frame(pca_after$rotation)
blood_loadings_after$Protein <- rownames(blood_loadings_after)
blood_annot_after <- blood_loadings_after %>% filter(tolower(Protein) %in% blood_markers_mouse)

p_pca_after <- p_pca_after +
  geom_text_repel(data = blood_annot_after, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Protein),
                  color = "blue", size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE)

# Combine PCA plots
p_pca_combined <- p_pca_before | p_pca_after

p_pca_combined

```



```{r 4th PART}
# 10. Blood protein paired boxplot
# ================================
before_blood <- colMeans(CSF_data[blood_markers, ])
after_blood  <- colMeans(corrected_data[blood_markers, ])


wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(before_blood, after_blood, paired = TRUE)
cat("Wilcoxon signed-rank test p-value for blood marker reduction:", wilcox_result$p.value, "\n")

blood_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rep(colnames(CSF_data), 2),
  Level = c(before_blood, after_blood),
  Stage = rep(c("Before", "After"), each = length(before_blood))
)

head(blood_df, 5)


p3 <- ggplot(blood_df, aes(x = Stage, y = Level, group = Sample)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Stage), size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle(paste0("Blood Protein Levels (p = ", signif(wilcox_result$p.value, 3), ")")) +
  ylab("Mean Blood Protein Intensity")

p3

# ================================
# 11. Combine all plots into one figure
# ================================
final_plot <- (p1 | p2_annotated) / (p_pca_combined | p3)
final_plot

# ================================
# 12. Save results
# ================================
ggsave("~/Desktop/KV1.3_CSF.PAP1.30july2025/CSF_BloodEffect_VPA_PCA_Annotated.png",
       final_plot, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300)

write.csv(corrected_data,
          "~/Desktop/KV1.3_CSF.PAP1.30july2025/CSF_PAP1_Proteinid_50percent_IMPUTATION_matrix.blood_corrected.csv")

```



```{r 5TH DATA}
# 1 Clean up NA values
vpa_before_clean <- vpa_before
vpa_before_clean[is.na(vpa_before_clean)] <- 0

vpa_after_clean <- vpa_after
vpa_after_clean[is.na(vpa_after_clean)] <- 0

# 2 Extract numeric vectors for blood score variance (as column, not row)
blood_var_before_vec <- vpa_before_clean$blood_score
blood_var_after_vec  <- vpa_after_clean$blood_score

# 3️ Calculate mean blood variance reduction
blood_var_before <- mean(blood_var_before_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
blood_var_after  <- mean(blood_var_after_vec, na.rm = TRUE)

variance_reduction <- ((blood_var_before - blood_var_after) / blood_var_before) * 100
cat("Blood effect variance reduced by:", round(variance_reduction, 2), "%\n")

# 4 QC: Top 50 proteins BEFORE correction
top_idx <- order(blood_var_before_vec, decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]

qc_df <- data.frame(
  Protein = rownames(vpa_before_clean)[top_idx],
  BloodVar_Before = blood_var_before_vec[top_idx],
  BloodVar_After  = blood_var_after_vec[top_idx]
)

print(qc_df)

# 5 Plot VPA AFTER correction
p2 <- plotVarPart(vpa_after_clean) +
  ggtitle("VPA - AFTER Blood Correction")

p2_annotated <- p2 +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2, y = max(blood_var_after_vec, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
           label = paste0("Blood effect ↓ ", round(variance_reduction, 1), "%"),
           color = "red", size = 5, fontface = "bold")

print(p2_annotated)


```


```{r Percentage-Based Stacked Bar Plot}
library(tidyverse)

# Convert to percentage for plotting
qc_df_long <- qc_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(BloodVar_Before, BloodVar_After),
               names_to = "Stage", values_to = "Variance") %>%
  group_by(Protein) %>%
  mutate(Variance_Percent = (Variance / sum(Variance, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Factor ordering by variance before correction (largest to smallest)
qc_df_long$Protein <- factor(qc_df_long$Protein,
                              levels = qc_df$Protein[order(qc_df$BloodVar_Before, decreasing = TRUE)])

# Plot stacked bar (percentage-based)
ggplot(qc_df_long, aes(x = Protein, y = Variance_Percent, fill = Stage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BloodVar_Before" = "red", "BloodVar_After" = "blue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 50 Proteins - Blood Effect Variance (Before vs After Correction)",
    x = "Proteins",
    y = "Variance Contribution (%)",
    fill = "Stage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )
library(variancePartition)

# Reorder proteins by blood effect before correction
GroupSortOrder <- order(vpa_before_clean[["blood_score"]], decreasing = TRUE)

# Reorder rows for all variance components
for (i in ls(vpa_before_clean)) { 
    vpa_before_clean[[i]] <- vpa_before_clean[[i]][GroupSortOrder]
}
rownames(vpa_before_clean) <- rownames(vpa_before_clean)[GroupSortOrder]

# Plot top 50 proteins based on blood variance (BEFORE correction)
plotPercentBars(vpa_before_clean[1:50, ]) +
    ggtitle("Top 50 Proteins Associated with Blood Effect (Before Correction)")

# After correction
GroupSortOrder <- order(vpa_after[["blood_score"]], decreasing = TRUE)

for (i in ls(vpa_after)) { 
    vpa_after[[i]] <- vpa_after[[i]][GroupSortOrder]
}
rownames(vpa_after) <- rownames(vpa_after)[GroupSortOrder]

plotPercentBars(vpa_after[1:50, ]) +
    ggtitle("Top 50 Proteins Associated with Blood Effect (After Correction)")
```


```{r COMBINED PLOTS}
library(variancePartition)
library(patchwork)   # for side-by-side plots

}
```

```{r PCA plot part2}

# Perform PCA before correction

  PC1 = pca_before$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_before$x[, 2],
  Group = CSF_metadata$Group
)

# Plot BEFORE correction
p_pca_before <- ggplot(pca_before_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_before)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1), "% variance)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_before)$importance[2, 2] * 100, 1), "% variance)")) +
  ggtitle("PCA - BEFORE Blood Correction") +

  PC1 = pca_after$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_after$x[, 2],
  Group = CSF_metadata$Group
)

# Plot AFTER correction

  geom_point(size = 4) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_after)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1), "% variance)")) +
```

```{r Median normalization for corrected data}
#PCA on corrected data before normalization

# Define a list of 10 distinct colors for the groups
color_list <- c('darkgreen', 'purple', 'brown', 'orange', 'pink', 'brown', 'grey', 'blue')

# Perform PCA with the specified color vector and other parameters
pca(corrected_data,
colvec = color_list,
labels = CSF_metadata$Treatment,
controlscale = TRUE,
scale = 3,
printres = TRUE,
printwidth = 25,
legendtitle = "Treatment")


#######
#colsum median normalization 
col_sums <- colSums(corrected_data, na.rm = TRUE)
 # Step 2: Compute the median of column sums
median_sum <- median(col_sums)
 # Step 3: Compute normalization factors (scale factors) 
norm_factors <- median_sum / col_sums
 # Step 4: Multiply each column by its corresponding normalization factor 
normalized_data <- sweep(corrected_data, 2, norm_factors, FUN = "*")
 dim(normalized_data)
 
 #write.csv(normalized_data, file = 'CSF.kv1.3.corrected.data.after.bloodcontamination.Normalized.csv')
```

```{r GO for PAP1 vs. Control}
library(readr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
diffEx_PAP1_vs_Control_CSF_KV1_3 <- read_csv("/Users/usri/Desktop/KV1.3_CSF.PAP1.30july2025/CSF.KV1.3.Proteomics.Analysis/diffEx.PAP1_vs_Control.CSF.KV1.3.csv")
## ---- Config ----
p_thresh   <- 0.05
lfc_up_thr <- 0
lfc_dn_thr <- 0

# Column names
p_col   <- "PAP1.vs.Control"       # raw p-value column
lfc_col <- "diff.PAP1.vs.Control"  # log2FC column

df <- diffEx_PAP1_vs_Control_CSF_KV1_3

# Coerce to numeric (safe)
df[[p_col]]   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[p_col]]))
df[[lfc_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[lfc_col]]))

# Label significance (use a single, consistent spelling)
df$significance <- ifelse(!is.na(df[[p_col]]) & df[[p_col]] < p_thresh & df[[lfc_col]] > lfc_up_thr, "Upregulated",
                   ifelse(!is.na(df[[p_col]]) & df[[p_col]] < p_thresh & df[[lfc_col]] < lfc_dn_thr, "Downregulated",
                          "Not.significant"))

# Helpers
df$minusLog10P <- -log10(df[[p_col]])
df$log2FC      <- df[[lfc_col]]

# Quick check
print(table(df$significance))


## GO plot
# Gene lists for GO
up_genes   <- df$Protein[df$significance == "Upregulated"]
down_genes <- df$Protein[df$significance == "Downregulated"]

# Background universe (vector of symbols)
Background <- unique(row.names(normalized_data))

# Save volcano-ready table
write.csv(df, file = "diffEx_PAP1.vs.Control.Volcano.csv")

## ---- UP-only GO Enrichment (BP/MF/CC) ----
ego_up_BP <- enrichGO(gene = up_genes, universe = Background,
                      OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
ego_up_BP_df <- as.data.frame(ego_up_BP@result); ego_up_BP_df$ONTOLOGY <- "BP"

ego_up_MF <- enrichGO(gene = up_genes, universe = Background,
                      OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "MF",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
ego_up_MF_df <- as.data.frame(ego_up_MF@result); ego_up_MF_df$ONTOLOGY <- "MF"

ego_up_CC <- enrichGO(gene = up_genes, universe = Background,
                      OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "CC",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
ego_up_CC_df <- as.data.frame(ego_up_CC@result); ego_up_CC_df$ONTOLOGY <- "CC"

## ---- Functions (older dplyr–safe) ----
add_minuslog10 <- function(d) {
  if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) return(d)
  d$pvalue <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$pvalue))
  d$minusLog10P <- -log10(d$pvalue)
  d
}

slice_top12 <- function(d) {
  if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) return(d)
  d$p.adjust <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$p.adjust))
  d <- d[order(d$p.adjust, na.last = NA), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) > 12) d <- d[1:12, , drop = FALSE]
  d
}

plot_go_top12 <- function(d, title_text, low_col, high_col, limit_max = 5) {
  if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) { message("No rows to plot for: ", title_text); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  ggplot(d, aes(x = reorder(Description, minusLog10P), y = minusLog10P, fill = minusLog10P)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.75) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = low_col, high = high_col,
                        limits = c(0, limit_max), oob = squish) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = "GO Term", y = "-log10(p-value)", fill = "-log10(p-value)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
}

## ---- Top-12 + Plots (UP) ----
ego_up_BP_df <- add_minuslog10(ego_up_BP_df)
ego_up_CC_df <- add_minuslog10(ego_up_CC_df)
ego_up_MF_df <- add_minuslog10(ego_up_MF_df)

top12_UP_BP <- slice_top12(ego_up_BP_df)
top12_UP_CC <- slice_top12(ego_up_CC_df)
top12_UP_MF <- slice_top12(ego_up_MF_df)

library(ggplot2)
library(scales)   # for squish

# safer plotting helper
plot_go_top12 <- function(d, title_text, low_col = "orange", high_col = "orange4", limit_max = 5) {
  if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) {
    message("No rows to plot for: ", title_text); 
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  low_col  <- as.character(low_col)
  high_col <- as.character(high_col)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = reorder(Description, minusLog10P), y = minusLog10P, fill = minusLog10P)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.75) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = low_col, high = high_col,
                        limits = c(0, limit_max), oob = scales::squish) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = "GO Term", y = "-log10(p-value)", fill = "-log10(p-value)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14))
}


P1 <- plot_go_top12(top12_UP_BP, "GO.BP:UP.PAP1.vs.Control", "orange",  "orange4", 5)
P2 <- plot_go_top12(top12_UP_CC, "GO.CC:UP.PAP1.vs.Control", "green4",  "darkgreen", 5)
P3 <- plot_go_top12(top12_UP_MF, "GO.MF:UP.PAP1.vs.ControlGO:MF", "purple",  "purple4", 5)

# View
P1; P2; P3
```

```{r Correlation between Brain and CSF proteomics data for PAP1 vs. Control}
CSF.KV1.3.cleanDat_PAP1.vs.Control <- readRDS("~/Desktop/KV1.3_CSF.PAP1.30july2025/CSF.KV1.3.Proteomics.Analysis/CSF.KV1.3.cleanDat_PAP1.vs.Control.rds")

CSF.KV1.3.NumericMeta_PAP1.vs.Control <- readRDS("~/Desktop/KV1.3_CSF.PAP1.30july2025/CSF.KV1.3.Proteomics.Analysis/CSF.KV1.3.NumericMeta_PAP1.vs.Control.rds")

meta_pap1_control.proteomics.brain <- readRDS("~/Downloads/meta_pap1_control.proteomics (1).rds")

expr_pap1_control.proteomics.brain <- readRDS("~/Downloads/expr_pap1_control.proteomics.rds")

## Correlation between Brain and CSF for PAP1

## 1) Make clean numeric matrices
CSF_mat   <- as.matrix(CSF.KV1.3.cleanDat_PAP1.vs.Control)
Brain_mat <- as.matrix(expr_pap1_control.proteomics.brain)

## 2) Fix brain rownames: keep SYMBOL before first underscore
brain_symbols <- sub("_.*$", "", rownames(Brain_mat))

## 3) Collapse duplicate symbols in brain by mean expression (base R)
Brain_df <- as.data.frame(Brain_mat, check.names = FALSE)
Brain_df$Symbol <- brain_symbols
Brain_sym <- aggregate(. ~ Symbol, data = Brain_df, FUN = function(x) mean(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE))
rownames(Brain_sym) <- Brain_sym$Symbol
Brain_sym$Symbol <- NULL
Brain_sym <- as.matrix(Brain_sym)

## 4) Find common proteins (symbols)
common_proteins <- intersect(rownames(CSF_mat), rownames(Brain_sym))
cat("Common proteins:", length(common_proteins), "\n")

stopifnot(length(common_proteins) > 2)  # need >2 for cor.test

## 5) Subset to common rows
CSF_c   <- CSF_mat[common_proteins, , drop = FALSE]
Brain_c <- Brain_sym[common_proteins, , drop = FALSE]

## 6) Normalize group labels
csf_group   <- toupper(CSF.KV1.3.NumericMeta_PAP1.vs.Control$Group)
brain_group <- toupper(meta_pap1_control.proteomics.brain$Group)

## 7) Average **expression** within PAP1 (no fold changes)
csf_mean_pap1   <- rowMeans(CSF_c[, csf_group   == "PAP1", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
brain_mean_pap1 <- rowMeans(Brain_c[, brain_group == "PAP1", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

## 8) Build df, drop non-finite, correlate
plot_df <- data.frame(
  Protein    = common_proteins,
  CSF_expr   = csf_mean_pap1[common_proteins],
  Brain_expr = brain_mean_pap1[common_proteins],
  row.names  = common_proteins
)
plot_df <- plot_df[is.finite(plot_df$CSF_expr) & is.finite(plot_df$Brain_expr), ]
cat("Usable proteins after NA/Inf filter:", nrow(plot_df), "\n")
stopifnot(nrow(plot_df) > 2)

cor_result <- cor.test(plot_df$CSF_expr, plot_df$Brain_expr, method = "pearson")
print(cor_result)

## 9) Plot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = CSF_expr, y = Brain_expr)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Brain vs CSF Expression (PAP1) — r = ",
                   round(cor_result$estimate, 2),
                   ", p = ", signif(cor_result$p.value, 3)),
    x = "CSF expression (avg PAP1)",
    y = "Brain expression (avg PAP1)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
